item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
Fixed

  • Panel appearance no longer breaks in Dark Mode — the outer panel background now matches the system theme correctly instead of staying stuck light.
  • Fixed the popover panel unexpectedly closing when opening Activity History (and the window flashing shut again on reopen).
  • Fixed the awake-mode tabs (Off / AI Active / Always) not filling the full width of their row.
  • Switching between Off / AI Active / Always no longer shifts the cards below it up or down.

Added

  • New Appearance setting (Settings → General): Light / Dark / Auto, defaults to Auto (follows system, same as before).
  • Awake-mode tabs now show a short explanation of what the selected mode does.
  • Activity History entries are now grouped by day and collapsible, one day open at a time.

Changed

  • "While AI is active" mode shortened to "AI Active" in the tab label (full meaning now shown underneath instead).

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
✨ Added

  • Uninstall UnIdle… in Settings › General puts your Mac back the way it was — sleep settings, Claude Code hooks, login item, permissions and settings — then moves UnIdle to the Trash. Your licence key is copied to the clipboard and this Mac's slot is freed, so you can use it again.
  • Sessions are grouped by agent, and every session shows its project name (e.g. Claude Code › billing-v2, api).
  • Setup now explains why each permission is needed and how to revoke it.

🔧 Changed

  • Lid-close on battery now uses a small helper installed with one standard macOS password prompt — no more "Apple could not verify this script" warning. Restore and Uninstall need no password.
  • A shut lid is held awake only while an agent is actually working, even in Always mode. With nothing running, the Mac sleeps as usual.
  • Updating from 0.1.1 (build 9) or later keeps every permission. Coming from an older version? Re-add UnIdle once in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.
  • If you used lid-close before, set it up once more in Settings › Power — the old password rule is no longer used.

🐛 Fixed

  • No more Keychain password prompts — the licence key is no longer stored in the Keychain.
  • Sessions now always get their project name; a broken start hook used to leave it blank.
  • The panel shrinks back to fit after switching to the Windowed layout.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
✨ Added

  • The Activity Log records every lid close — whether UnIdle kept the Mac awake (and for which agent), or why it slept: no agent working, Always mode with nothing running, Pro needed, or lid-close switched off.
  • It also logs when the Mac slept and woke, and when the lid was opened.
  • Entries now show the agent and project, e.g. "Awake — Claude Code · billing-v2 running".

🐛 Fixed

  • Your licence key is kept after updating to 0.1.3. It's moved out of the Keychain silently, so Uninstall and Deactivate free this Mac's slot again. No password prompts.

Signed & notarized by Apple. Installs cleanly, no Gatekeeper warnings.
